info.title: NCrawl Browser API
info.description: Local, loopback-only API that controls NCrawl Browser sessions (Playwright/Chromium) for authorized inspection. All responses use the envelope { ok: true, data } or { ok: false, error }. Error codes: INVALID_INPUT, URL_NOT_ALLOWED, PROFILE_NOT_FOUND, PROFILE_IN_USE, SESSION_NOT_FOUND, SESSION_NOT_RUNNING, PAGE_NOT_FOUND, PAGE_CRASHED, BROWSER_LAUNCH_FAILED, BROWSER_CRASHED, NAVIGATION_TIMEOUT, NAVIGATION_FAILED, HISTORY_UNAVAILABLE, CAPTURE_FAILED, INSPECTION_FAILED, SESSION_PAUSED, SESSION_STOPPED, PAGE_BUSY, UNAUTHORIZED, FORBIDDEN, NOT_FOUND, METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED, UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE, PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE, INTERNAL.
